listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Refillable Spray 50ml - 50ml
listings.description: INTRODUCING MY WAY; THE NEW FEMININE FRAGRANCE BY GIORGIO ARMANI Giorgio Armani, designer of timeless fragrances, unveils its new fragrance; MY WAY. Through meaningful connections to others, one finds the path to the truest version of oneself. I AM WHAT I LIVEMY WAY is inspired by the genuine search for meaning and authenticity that lies outside oneself, ultimately creating a more profound way of being. Through the influence of serendipitous encounters and new experiences, one discovers one’s own multifaceted depths. Intimate yet universal, “I am what I live” encapsulates this ethos.FINDING ON HER OWN PATHA fragrance for a new generation, MY WAY encapsulates curiosity and connections, embodied by a woman looking for experiences that challenge her preconceptions and take her into new, unchartered territory. She seeks out meaningful, authentic ways of connecting with others. Through truly learning from others, she reinvents and finds herself. Embodied by authentic and unfiltered beauty, actor Adria Arjona. She is curious and open. Learning from others, whilst discovering the world is how she forms a stronger sense of self. “You can take anything away from me, but you can’t take away what I’ve lived” Adria Arjona, Global Ambassador for MY WAY.CAPTURING MEANINGFUL ENCOUNTERS OF THE WORLDMY WAY is a contemporary floral fragrance with a fusion of white flowers at its heart. The fragrance is composed of the finest natural ingredients: Vanilla is sourced from Madagascar through an inclusive program that benefits local communities, while the Tuberose is harvested in India. In creating the notes, craftsmanship meets innovation, as the Tuberose heart is extracted using molecular distillation, allowing the perfumers to select the creamy, velvety facets tailor-made for MY WAY. The Orange blossom note is extracted in Egypt using an innovative, exclusive and entirely natural enfleurage process, whose cold extraction method infuses the Orange flowers in Orange essence. The artisanal approach finally translates in the manual weighing and blending of the fragrance’s concentrate in Grasse creates pure, highly-refined notes with enhanced radiance and naturality. CAPTURING LIVED EXPERIENCES IN A BOTTLE MY WAY’s sleek design and transparent glass, combined with vibrant pink juice, explore the multiple facets of femininity and gives light and luminosity. The deep blue rounded cap, a new interpretation of the iconic Armani stone, acts as a metaphor for the planet and encapsulates all of ones experiences with others. With a golden ring around the cap and real rich fabric around the collar, creating a timeless couture accessory. An elegant bottle of true Armani contrasts acting as a talisman as you find your own path. Storytelling and precious, but also responsible. Exemplifying Giorgio Armani beauty’s commitment to the environment, the MY WAY bottle reinvents fine fragrance for a more sustainable future. Created with an innovative and seamless refill system, with all its components recyclable, MY WAY ‘s bottle makes it effortless to both reduce waste and recycle more.CAPTURING A LIVED EXPERIENCEDirected and photographed by Hunter & Gatti, the MY WAY campaign captures Adria Arjona’s adventure, with the Spanish creative duo following her as she experiences meaningful encounters with people and places around the world. More than a campaign, the unretouched film is a live experience capturing Adria as she arrives at these authentic moments of connection with others, through the rituals of their diverse cultures. The introduction of MY WAY also reflects of Giorgio Armani’s long-standing commitment to sustainability, through actions such as its innovative, refillable and recyclable flacon, and opens a new era of sustainability with a new ambition: fight against climate change.Fragrance Family: FloralTop notes: Bergamot from Calabria & Orange Blossom from EgyptHeart notes: Tuberose & Jasmine from IndiaBase notes: Cedarwood from Virginia, Vanilla from Madagascar & White Musks

Notes of neroli, mandarin orange, orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose are wrapped in gentle musks and powdery nuances, creating a clean, comforting trail that feels both modern and timeless.This fragrance fits effortlessly into a daily routine, working just as well for relaxed weekends as it does for the office or evening occasions. It may particularly appeal to anyone who loves fresh, feminine florals with a subtle sweetness and a refined, skin-like finish. Spritz onto pulse points as the final step in your grooming ritual to enjoy a soft veil of scent that lingers close and complements rather than competes with your personal style.Why we love it- Showcases the joyful character of orange blossom, balanced with neroli, jasmine and tuberose for a refined white floral scent.- Offers a soft, skin-like finish with musks and powdery notes that feels elegant rather than overpowering.- Versatile enough for day or evening, making it an easy signature fragrance for lovers of fresh, feminine florals.- Works beautifully as the final touch to a grooming ritual, adding a subtle veil of sophistication in any season.How to useHow to Use:Apply to clean, dry skin. Spray Prada Infusion de Fleur d'Oranger Eau de Parfum onto pulse points such as the wrists, inner elbows, neck and behind the ears. Allow the fragrance to settle on the skin without rubbing. Reapply if you’d like to refresh the scent during the day.Frequency:Use as needed, according to the product instructions and your fragrance preference.Application Technique:Hold the bottle a few inches away from the skin and spray a light mist directly onto pulse points. For a more diffused effect, mist lightly into the air and walk through the fragrance cloud so it settles evenly over skin and clothing, taking care with delicate fabrics.Best Practices:Apply after bathing or moisturising to help the scent cling to the skin. Start with a small amount and build up if desired, especially in warmer weather or close-contact settings. Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.Safety Tips:For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and always follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Aftershave Lotion Splash 125ml
listings.description: In 1995, the fragrance Le Male revolutionised the world of perfumery by offering a non-conformist view of masculinity. As virile as it is sexy, it pays tribute to a symbolic figure who has long been a source of inspiration for the designer: The Sailor. A torso-shaped bottle with unashamed masculine attributes. The iconoclastic designer appropriates an everyday object and transforms it into an artistic case: the now-famous metal can.The power and freshness of mint and lavender evoke the familiar and comforting scent of shaving soap and is transformed by the sensuality of vanilla. This classic fragrance flouts convention and plays it two ways between tradition and audacity, freshness and softness, strength and sensuality. A truly versatile scent perfect for both casual and formal wear.Top notes: Cardamom, Bergamot, Mint, Lavender, Artemisia.Middle notes: Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Caraway.Base notes: Cedar, Vanilla, Amber, Tonka Bean, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Boucheron Place Vendôme Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Place Vendôme is a woody, floral fragrance that was launched in 2013. The scent opens with top notes of pink pepper, orange blossom and rose essence. Middle notes are honey, Jasmine and peony. Base notes are benzoin and cedar-wood.

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin Eclat d'Arpege Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Launched in 2003, this sophisticated fragrance has floral top notes and musky base notes that combine to create a joyful, feminine scent. Composed of peony, peach blossom, tea leaf, green lilac, amber, musk, Chinese osmanthus, petit grain, wisteria, and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentlemen Only Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Presenting a contemporary adaptation of a celebrated classic; Gentlemen Only by Givenchy lifts traditional citrus and aromatic accords, instead focusing on bold and masculine woody essences.A sharp, fresh and spicy gambit applies nutmeg, pink pepper and birch leaf into the citrus nuances of bergamot and mandarin. The heart promises a deep accord set with woody cedar, patchouli and vetiver before a smoky base of musk and incense.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Amour Eau de Parfum Spray 50ml
listings.description: Kenzo Amour was launched in 2006. This musky, floral fragrance contains notes of Cherry, Frangipani blossoms, Woods, Incense, Thanaka wood, Rice, White Tea and Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Fuel For Life Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Diesel Fuel For Life Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml is a vibrant men’s fragrance designed for those who enjoy a sense of energy and spontaneity. The scent blends bright grapefruit with aromatic star anise, moving into a heart of smooth lavender and juicy raspberry. It settles into a warm base of heliotrope and dry woods, creating a balance of freshness, subtle sweetness and sensual depth that feels modern yet easy to wear day to day.This fragrance suits men who like a confident, spirited scent that works from daytime through to evening without feeling overpowering. It fits seamlessly into a grooming routine as a finishing touch after showering, shaving or getting ready to go out. The eau de toilette format offers a lighter feel on the skin while still leaving a noticeable trail. Ideal for work, weekends or evenings out, it’s a versatile choice for anyone who wants a fragrance that helps to express personality and adds a polished final step to their routine.Why we love it- Combines bright grapefruit and star anise with lavender, raspberry and warm woods for a lively yet refined scent- Offers a balance of freshness and subtle sweetness that works well from day to night- Sits comfortably on the skin as an eau de toilette, making it easy to wear every day- Fits seamlessly into a grooming routine as a simple final step that adds a polished, confident finishing touchHow to useHow to Use:Apply Diesel Fuel For Life Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml to clean, dry skin. Start with a small amount and build if you prefer a more noticeable scent. Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight to help preserve the fragrance.Safety Tips:For external use only. Avoid spraying directly into the eyes or on irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional instructions on the packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Night For Women Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession Night For Women Eau de Parfum is a deeper, moodier twist on a classic fragrance, created for evenings when you want to feel confident and quietly seductive. The scent opens with a luminous blend of mandarin, bergamot, bitter orange and white flowers, bringing a fresh yet slightly mysterious first impression. At the heart, jasmine, gardenia, lily and rose add a soft floral richness, before settling into a warm base of vanilla, sandalwood, tonka bean, cashmere and honey that lingers beautifully on the skin without feeling overpowering.This fragrance is designed for women who enjoy a sensual, floral-woody scent with a touch of sweetness, especially for night-time wear or special occasions. Avoid contact with eyes and irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and always follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

listings.rawTitle: JOOP! Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Joop! Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml is a confident, woody amber fragrance created for those who enjoy a blend of strength and softness. The scent opens with a lively rush of aldehydes and fresh fruity tones, brightened by bergamot and lemon, with a touch of coriander adding aromatic depth. At its heart, a bouquet of orange blossom, jasmine, lily of the valley and rose brings a classic, feminine character that feels both nostalgic and timeless on the skin.As it settles, the fragrance reveals a warm, sensual base of sandalwood, patchouli, musk and cedar, enriched with amber, vanilla, tonka bean, civet and oakmoss. The result is a distinctive trail that feels smooth, enveloping and quietly powerful.
